scope: Curated actual-prompt aliases, idioms, and grammar access routes supplementing a sense-specific lexical index. Some routes have no single-word equivalent. Instructional English is excluded.
source_policy: Reuse accepted prompt/key/source evidence at the linked current item IDs; preserve the original Cook hints and corrections. Contextual synonym access does not widen an assigned sense or case frame.
target_resolution: Resolve oe_targets by sense_id to the current canonical glossary entry/display headword. Stored headword is register provenance, not an overriding learner display. Preserve the complete usage_note for grouped choices.

ðēah with the taught concessive clause; a subjunctive need not make an admitted fact unreal.

gif does not by itself choose a mood; open, tentative and counterfactual conditions have distinct taught frames.
Invariant ðe or inflected relative/demonstrative; case belongs to the clause role, not automatically the antecedent's case.

Appropriate finite wesan/weorðan plus the taught passive participle; distinguish a state, event and simple lexical become.
Simple OE finite forms can render English progressive aspect; wesan + present participle is only one bounded source construction, not a required default.
